findings.claim: The late-commit check is now in O4 (the bump commit and pull request body carry a Drafted-From trailer) and O5 (release-tag finds the drafted commit and names late commits in a warning and step summary). Eval rows r4 and r5 test both.

The notes file no longer carries a marker. The drafted commit is the bump commit's parent on release/TAG, or the Drafted-From trailer on a squash merge. Hermes' cleaning and a human edit cannot touch either.

VERSION starts at 0.1.0.dev0. scripts/release.py compare checks for a .dev version before it checks for an empty OLD (release.py:234-237), so the landing push gets skip. The first release passes --version 0.1.0, which next_release_version already requires when no tag exists, and 0.1.0 compares as raised against 0.1.0.dev0. O1 and r1 test this.
